text: Paper-named detector constructors now return EventDetector(card, machine), preventing algorithm identity from being passed independently of executable code. I-VT and I-DT pin Salvucci and Goldberg 2000 DOI 10.1145/355017.355028; Engbert-Kliegl pins DOI 10.1016/S0042-6989(03)00084-1 plus GPL-3.0 toolbox revision a3eba6e9f1464c953c81fbd87944ba7678c2cf64 and source path. Assumptions, execution mode, and deviations are closed enums; metadata identities and versions parse through smart constructors.
